region.title: Region
region.description: The tables' AWS region, such as us-east-1. Default: AWS_REGION where the connector runs, or the AWS default config's.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: A DynamoDB-compatible endpoint instead of the region's: a VPC endpoint, or DynamoDB Local's, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000. Its streams are read at the same endpoint.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials: an IAM role the source names, or what the runner passes on.

secretAccessKey.title: Secret access key
secretAccessKey.description: The access key's secret. Needed with accessKeyId.

sessionToken.title: Session token
sessionToken.description: For temporary credentials from AWS STS: their session token, with their access key and secret.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: The tables to offer as streams. Empty: every table in the region the credentials can list.

packed.title: Packed items
packed.description: Read each item whole: every stream is the table's key attributes and data, a JSON column with the item in DynamoDB JSON, which keeps every type, instead of a column per top-level attribute. Discovery reads only the keys, and no read fails on a new attribute.

sampleSize.title: Discovery sample
sampleSize.description: Items discovery reads of each table, from random scan segments, to find its attributes and their types. 0: every item, so that a read never meets an attribute discovery didn't declare, at the cost of a scan of each table per discovery. A sample can miss a rare attribute, and a read that meets it fails and starts again until a sample finds it: set 0, or packed, for tables with rare attributes.

segments.title: Scan segments
segments.description: Parallel scan segments each table is read in, as splits OpenETL can read at once, and in a cdc snapshot. 0: one per GiB the table holds, as DescribeTable reports it, up to 64.

scanLimit.title: Items per scan request
scanLimit.description: The most items one Scan request reads; each request ends at a resume point. 0: as many as fit DynamoDB's 1 MB page.

x-groups.title: Credentials
x-groups.description: An access key, or else the AWS default credentials.

x-groups.title: Tables
x-groups.description: Which tables are streams, and how their items become columns.
